integrity: Automorphism and derivation parametrizations are established prior knowledge and not asserted as new. The distinct claim is the complete conjugacy-orbit classification.
scientific_limitations: Ordinary derivations of one specific three-dimensional left Leibniz algebra over finite fields only. No independent validation. Small-field replay does not establish generality; the general proof is algebraic. Historical equivalence remains possible, especially in incompletely accessible 2026 preprint sections.
title: Automorphism-conjugacy classes of derivations of the three-dimensional null-filiform Leibniz algebra
